outcomes.name_verbatim: Right heart systolic dysfunction (multivariate logistic regression)
outcomes.definition_verbatim: Right ventricular systolic dysfunction was defined as TAPSE < 16 mm, an indication of the excursion of the longitudinal fibers, revealing the contribution of the RV to systolic contraction.

provenance.quote: Stepwise regression analysis showed that the following variables were independent predictors of right heart systolic dysfunction: titration method (OR=0.03, 95%CI 0.00-0.07, p=0.029) and compliance (OR=0.85, 95%CI 0.74-0.97, p=0.020

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: all patients met the 2012 Berlin ARDS definition. obesity_subgroup unclear: BMI not reported; only weight (mean 64.1 kg) is given. timing_subgroup unclear: titration began at onset of mechanical ventilation per protocol (Fig 1), but no interval from intubation/ICU admission/ARDS onset is quantified. ptp_target_subgroups: only the TPO arm used esophageal/absolute Ptp targets (end-expiratory Ptp 0-10 cmH2O); the G and DPO arms did not use Ptp, but the study as a whole contributes to the absolute positive end-expiratory Ptp subgroup via its TPO arm. Mortality ranking: 28-day mortality is the only mortality timepoint reported, so it is the longest.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlap with any COHORTS.md cluster. Single centre (Shaanxi Provincial People's Hospital, Xi'an, China), enrolment April 2020 to December 2021, no trial registration reported. Does not match epvent1/epvent2 (different centres, dates), mannheim_boesing, mgh_lung_rescue, or angers clusters. Cohort unique to this report, so cohort_id is null.
unclear_items: population.ards_severity.severe: text reports 31 severe cases but Table 2 severe row sums to 27 (20+4+3); mild count (7) is derived from Table 2 only. Discrepancy unresolved.

Abstract states PEEP 'significantly higher for TPO than for G (p=0.616)' but Results text and Table 3 give p=0.005/p=0.009 for the 72-h PEEP comparison; the abstract p=0.616 appears to be a typographical error.
population.bmi: not reported; obesity_subgroup coded unclear.

design.randomised: coded false — the study is explicitly observational and 'The method of titrating PEEP and rescue treatments were at the discretion of the attending physician'; group allocation mechanism otherwise not described.
feasibility.n_placement_attempted: derived as 10 (TPO group size) because the paper never states how many catheters were placed or whether placement succeeded in all.

Table 2 footnote symbols: text layer shows '#' for both DPO-vs-G and TPO-vs-DPO markers inconsistently between text layer and rendered image; marker attribution for some cells (e.g. Cts 72h DPO 33.1±7.8#) taken from the rendered image.

intervention.timing.reference_event: coded intubation/onset of mechanical ventilation per Fig 1 ('Basic mechanical ventilation for 10 mins' then allocation), but the paper never quantifies time from intubation to titration.
data_only_in_figure: Fig 3: full multivariate logistic regression results (Models 1-4: right systolic dysfunction, right diastolic dysfunction, right ventricular dilatation, acute cor pulmonale) with ORs and p-values for all candidate variables — only the titration-method and compliance ORs for Model 1 are quoted in the text; the remaining coefficients would require digitisation/transcription from the figure.
extraction_flags.general_notes: Esophageal pressure and transpulmonary pressure values are reported in Table 3 for all three groups, although the methods describe esophageal balloon insertion only for the TPO group; how Pes was measured in G and DPO groups is not explained. The primary endpoint stated in the Methods is the incidence of right heart dysfunction (RV dilatation RVEDA/LVEDA >0.6, ACP, TAPSE <16 mm, tricuspid E/A <0.8); incidence counts per group are not tabulated and are only shown in Fig 3 regression models. Echocardiography outcomes (TAPSE, RVFAC, Tei index, E/A, etc.) at baseline and 72 h are in Table 4 and were not transcribed as outcome entries because they fall outside the review's physiologic domains; they are available in Table 4, p. 132. Table 4 column headers print 72h before Baseline; values were assigned to timepoints by the rendered image layout. Funding is a provincial government research programme, not industry.
